prompt_head_discrepancy.issue: AUDIT_PROMPT.md names frozen content head 8a9b0ee53c72062a0a68738082e5a056fad38f27. The audit actually ran against 7955ef33d7c0ab29daecbab966bc6a9497dc69ce, which is one commit later (the A21 value-grounding fix).
prompt_head_discrepancy.cause: The prompt was authored before a producer self-adversarial probe found a real validator false-green. Fixing it added a commit, moving the content head after the prompt text was written.
prompt_head_discrepancy.auditor_statement: HEAD is `7955ef33`, not stated freeze `8a9b0ee`. Checking that, then reading ADR candidates, inventory, and contracts.
prompt_head_discrepancy.handling: The prompt was NOT rewritten to match. It is the artifact that was actually executed, and editing it to name a head it did not name would be falsifying custody. The discrepancy is recorded here instead.
prompt_head_discrepancy.material_effect: None on scope. The auditor read the worktree it was placed in, which is the later head, and it verified that head itself. The bytes audited are a strict superset improvement over the bytes named.

route.read_only_intent: The prompt instructs no modification. The auditor was placed in a throwaway detached worktree so that command execution could be approved without any possibility of touching the reviewed artifacts.
